name: PVOD source-supported day-ahead QGBM study
evaluated_window: The non-overlapping 28.00 to 51.75 hour interval after each daily 12:00 UTC issue time.
restriction: PVOD records do not expose forecast-run identifiers. This is a source-supported operational convention based on the documented daily 12:00 UTC WRF initialization and 28 to 54 hour forecast range, not a vintage-verified archive.
